tagline: Front-engined sports cars and grand tourers as hover jets: a turbine in the bonnet, a turbine standing through the tail deck, a lift jet in every arch.

longnose.name: Longnose

parts.note: front seam plate: dark linkage in the shadow gap
door skin; sill pad at X 4.7
long scuttle: the bonnet line runs on into the cabin
tall upright windscreen, set far back
short flat roof, tall and narrow
bright roof lip over the notch

longnose.note: 60s long-bonnet GT: a small, tall, upright box cabin set far back behind a long scuttle. Thin pillars, tall glass, a bright roof lip over a deep notch, then a short fastback.

teardrop.name: Teardrop

parts.note: front seam plate: dark linkage in the shadow gap
door skin; sill pad at X 4.7
tail curve, cut off square at the engine hatch
buttress carrying the curve on beside the engine

teardrop.note: Rear-engined coupe: screen right at the cowl, a tall round dome, then one curve down. The tail is open between two buttresses so the rear engine shows.

bruiser.name: Bruiser

parts.note: front seam plate: dark linkage in the shadow gap
door skin; sill pad at X 4.7
shoulder falling to the back seam
chopped roof, out to the shoulders
C-pillar closing in to the buttress
buttress falling to the deck beside the engine hatch
sunk rear window between the buttresses

bruiser.note: Modern muscular GT: the lowest roof, chopped to 4.3 and as wide as the shoulders. Slit glass, a wrap-round screen, double bubble, and two flying buttresses that carry the roof line back beside the engine.

roadster.name: Roadster

parts.note: front seam plate: dark linkage in the shadow gap
door skin; sill pad at X 4.7

roadster.note: Open two-seater: low framed screen, driver in the open, twin head fairings.

brake.name: Brake

parts.note: front seam plate: dark linkage in the shadow gap
door skin; sill pad at X 4.7
load-bay glass, closed off ahead of the engine
load-bay side glass beside the engine
flat roof, ending over the engine
roof rail over the open load bay
tailgate header: an open frame, no glass

brake.note: Shooting brake: the longest roofline. One flat line to an upright tailgate frame. Roof and tailgate are open over the rear engine.

gullwing.name: Gullwing

parts.note: front seam plate: dark linkage in the shadow gap
door skin; sill pad at X 4.7
sill falling to the back seam
door frame, standing proud of the glass
door top, hinged on the spine
spine fin running down to the deck

gullwing.note: Gullwing: a narrow canopy leaning in hard over deep sills. A raised roof spine carries the door hinges and runs on down the back as a fin.

inline_stack.name: Inline Stack

parts.note: tray plate out to the bay edge

inline_stack.note: Classic GT: one long slim turbine under six intake stacks, with a log manifold each side. Slim side pipes.

twin_ram.name: Twin Ram

parts.note: tray plate out to the bay edge
low ram turbine, flush with the wing line

twin_ram.note: Rear-engine sports: two low turbines in the front half of the bay, tops flush with the wing line, then a flush lid with two inlet slots. Small side exits.

big_single.name: Big Single

parts.note: tray plate out to the bay edge

big_single.note: Modern GT: one big turbine set back against the cowl under a power dome. Twin slot exits each side.

quad_throttle.name: Quad Throttle

parts.note: tray plate out to the bay edge

quad_throttle.note: Roadster: four small jets stacked two by two in the middle of the bay. Twin pipes each side.

ram_scoop.name: Ram Scoop

parts.note: tray plate out to the bay edge

ram_scoop.note: Shooting brake: a wide turbine case under a tall ram scoop. One fat side dump each side.

bonnet_slot.name: Bonnet Slot

parts.note: flat slot jet in the bonnet

bonnet_slot.note: GT3: a flat duct the full width of the bay at bonnet height, with a slot jet and vanes standing above it. Box vents each side.

tail_twin.name: Tail Twin

parts.note: tray plate out to the hatch edge
intake trumpet standing through the deck
intake trumpet standing through the deck

tail_twin.note: Classic GT: two slim turbines side by side, the full length of the hatch, each under two intake trumpets.

fat_single.name: Fat Single

parts.note: tray plate out to the hatch edge
fan turret standing through the deck

fat_single.note: Rear-engine sports: one fat turbine three studs wide with a tall fan turret at the front and one big nozzle.

quad_square.name: Quad Square

parts.note: tray plate out to the hatch edge
housing top standing through the deck

quad_square.note: Modern GT: two intake ducts feeding a square housing at the back of the hatch, with four nozzles in a square.

triple_tube.name: Triple Tube

parts.note: tray plate out to the hatch edge
intake log standing through the deck

triple_tube.note: Roadster: three tubes in a row, fed by an intake log that lies across them above the deck.

splay_vee.name: Splay Vee

parts.note: tray plate out to the hatch edge
bright top plate standing through the deck

splay_vee.note: Shooting brake: a tall block at the front of the hatch with two tall, narrow, square-cut nozzles splayed apart in a vee.

slot_vector.name: Slot Vector

parts.note: tray plate out to the hatch edge
ram scoop standing through the deck
thin flat nozzle, pitched down at the tail
slot jet, the full width of the nozzle

slot_vector.note: GT3: a ram scoop on a low plenum, then one thin flat nozzle the full width of the hatch, held high over open air and pitched down at the tail between two side plates.

torpedo_lifts.name: Torpedo Lifts
torpedo_lifts.note: Classic GT: one slim torpedo per corner, nozzle canted down and back.

twin_columns.name: Twin Columns
twin_columns.note: Rear-engine sports: two upright lift tubes per corner.

vane_boxes.name: Vane Boxes
vane_boxes.note: Modern GT: a flat louvred box low in the arch, one wide sheet of thrust.

slant_jets.name: Slant Jets

parts.note: pod body on the arch wall
pod body on the arch wall

slant_jets.note: Roadster: one vee-nozzle unit per corner. A pod high in the arch with two short fat dark nozzles splayed fore and aft. The tips stop just under the sill, tucked in the arch.

comb_jets.name: Comb Jets
comb_jets.note: Shooting brake: a slim rail high in the arch with a row of five thin down-pipes.

outriggers.name: Outriggers

parts.note: stub winglet from the arch wall, over the nacelle
intake slot in the winglet tip
stub winglet from the arch wall, over the nacelle
intake slot in the winglet tip

outriggers.note: GT3: one big lift nacelle per corner, hung under its own body-colour stub winglet from the arch wall and firing straight down.

megaphones.name: Twin Megaphones

parts.note: dark petal collar: the megaphone mouth

megaphones.note: Classic GT: one long megaphone each side, far apart. A slim pipe that flares in two steps to a wide mouth, the longest burner in the class.

stacked_twins.name: Stacked Twins
stacked_twins.note: Rear-engine sports: two short fat cans each side, one high and inboard, one low and outboard, on one surround plate.

quad_tips.name: Quad Tips
quad_tips.note: Modern GT: four squared tips in one row across the centre, low under the rear engine nozzles.

cannon.name: Single Cannon

parts.note: long dark barrel, longer than it is wide

cannon.note: Roadster: one long dark cannon, on the right side only.

staged_pairs.name: Staged Pairs
staged_pairs.note: Shooting brake: a long fat pipe close in, with a short slim pipe outboard of it, each side.

blade_burners.name: Blade Burners

parts.note: long upright can, as tall as the transom band
upright slot jet, standing proud of the collar
intake scoop on the outboard face, mouth forward

blade_burners.note: GT3: one upright slot burner at each tail corner. A long square-cut can as tall as the transom band, an intake scoop on its outboard face, a dark collar and an upright slot jet.

torpedo_nose.name: Torpedo Nose

parts.note: bonnet bay floor: Engine1 pad at Y 1.0
blanked arch wall and cove back: lift-jet pad at X 3.3
wing top falling from the cowl
nose tapers to a blunt point in plan
dark underbody following the nose taper: backing for wide chins

torpedo_nose.note: Classic GT: the longest and lowest nose. The wing line falls from the cowl to a pointed tip. Oval mouth, lamps under glass.

frogeye_nose.name: Frogeye Nose

parts.note: bonnet bay floor: Engine1 pad at Y 1.0
blanked arch wall and cove back: lift-jet pad at X 3.3
chin shelf at Y 0, under the bumper
chin shelf corner: backing for wide chins
wrap-round bumper under the lamps: it carries the short nose forward at chin height
bumper corner, swept round to the wing
front corner, rounded off in plan
wing front rising from the lamp
wing crest rising to its peak over the arch
wing crest falling to the cowl
lamp pod, low at the front
low intake slot in the bumper

frogeye_nose.note: Rear-engine sports: the shortest nose. A low lid between two wings that peak over the arch, each with a round lamp pod low at the front, over a wrap-round bumper.

shark_nose.name: Shark Nose

parts.note: bonnet bay floor: Engine1 pad at Y 1.0
blanked arch wall and cove back: lift-jet pad at X 3.3
chin shelf at Y 0: chin pad in the middle, backing for wide chins outboard
wing hump rising over the arch
wing hump falling to the cowl
long corner cut: the nose comes to a blunt point in plan
bonnet leading edge, drooping to the mouth

shark_nose.note: Modern GT: long, wide and tall. The wings hump high over the arches, with wide flares and a blunt nose with a big mouth.

clubman_nose.name: Clubman Nose

parts.note: chin shelf at Y 0: chin pad in the middle, backing for wide chins outboard
chin shelf corner, swept back beside the cone: backing for wide chins
bonnet bay floor: Engine1 pad at Y 1.0
bonnet side: lift-jet pad at X 3.3
bonnet side rising to the beltline
scuttle flare out to the seam width

clubman_nose.note: Roadster: a narrow, low nose cone with open front corners over a swept dark apron. The lift jets stand in the open air and the lamps ride on posts.

estate_nose.name: Square Nose

parts.note: bonnet bay floor: Engine1 pad at Y 1.0
blanked arch wall and cove back: lift-jet pad at X 3.3
chin shelf at Y 0: chin pad in the middle, backing for wide chins outboard

estate_nose.note: Shooting brake: a square upright nose at full bonnet height. Bright grille, four round lamps, wing-top mirrors.

works_nose.name: Works Nose

parts.note: bonnet bay floor: Engine1 pad at Y 1.0
blanked arch wall and cove back: lift-jet pad at X 3.3
chin shelf at Y 0: chin pad in the middle, backing for wide chins outboard
arch top falling to the beltline
arch closing in to the door over the cove

works_nose.note: GT3: box arches out to the limit with louvres, low short nose, bonnet duct. Behind the arch the box closes in to the door in a long taper.

kamm_tail.name: Kamm Tail

parts.note: tail bay floor: Engine2 pad at Y 1.0
blanked arch wall: lift-jet pad at X 3.3
haunch; deck and spoiler pad at Y 3.0
haunch; deck and spoiler pad at Y 3.0 top
hip line rising to the high cut-off

kamm_tail.note: Classic GT: the shortest tail. The hips rise to a high edge and the tail is cut off square. Twin round lamps.

wide_hips.name: Wide Hips

parts.note: tail bay floor: Engine2 pad at Y 1.0
blanked arch wall: lift-jet pad at X 3.3
haunch; deck and spoiler pad at Y 3.0
tail slopes away to a low edge

wide_hips.note: Rear-engine sports: the widest road tail. Round hips swell over the arches, then the tail slopes away to a low edge.

muscle_haunch.name: Muscle Haunch

parts.note: tail bay floor: Engine2 pad at Y 1.0
blanked arch wall: lift-jet pad at X 3.3
haunch; deck and spoiler pad at Y 3.0
haunch; deck and spoiler pad at Y 3.0 top

muscle_haunch.note: Modern GT: a tall haunch peaking over the arch, arch flares, and a long undercut tail edge over slit lamps.

boat_tail.name: Boat Tail

parts.note: tail bay floor: Engine2 pad at Y 1.0
blanked arch wall: lift-jet pad at X 3.3
narrow deck beside the bay; spoiler pad at Y 3.0
seam flare closing in behind the door
rear quarter top; spoiler pad at Y 3.0

boat_tail.note: Roadster: open rear corners and the longest tail. The lift jets stand in the open air, then the tail closes in to a pointed stern.

estate_tail.name: Square Tail

parts.note: tail bay floor: Engine2 pad at Y 1.0
blanked arch wall: lift-jet pad at X 3.3
haunch; deck and spoiler pad at Y 3.0
haunch; deck and spoiler pad at Y 3.0 top
side rail rising from the door

estate_tail.note: Shooting brake: a square tail with tall side rails and tall lamp columns. Its deck ends at Z 11.0, close behind the Brake tailgate.

works_tail.name: Works Tail

parts.note: tail bay floor: Engine2 pad at Y 1.0
blanked arch wall: lift-jet pad at X 3.3
haunch; deck and spoiler pad at Y 3.0
box arch swelling from the seam
box arch closing in to the tail

works_tail.note: GT3: box arches out to the limit, louvres, then a narrow stripped tail. The box swells from the door seam and closes in again behind the arch.

parts.note: intake scoop ahead of the rear arch

flat_floor.name: Flat Floor

parts.note: floor tapering in to the door at the front
floor tapering in to the door at the back
floor fence, ramping up towards the rear arch

flat_floor.note: GT3: a flat floor standing 0.6 out from the door, tapered to a point at both ends, with a fence ramping up towards the rear arch.

valance.name: Valance

parts.note: valance corner, cut back in plan

valance.note: Rear-engine sports: a body-colour valance with cut-back corners, so it follows a pointed nose as well as a square one.

lip.name: Lip
lip.note: Modern GT: a thin dark lip with swept corners. It shows a quarter of a stud round a blunt nose and hides under a long one.

air_dam.name: Air Dam
air_dam.note: Shooting brake: a deep upright air dam, set back and kept inside the narrowest nose.

splitter.name: Splitter

parts.note: end fence, under the body side

splitter.note: GT3: a dark splitter plate with swept corners and a short bright leading edge, the widest and longest chin. End fences hang under the body side, strakes under the plate.

parts.note: diffuser floor, flush with the body side
kick-up block: the blade hangs from this

blade_bumper.name: Blade Bumper

parts.note: step block, full depth, straight under the valance corner
bright step plate, tucked under the tail

blade_bumper.note: Shooting brake: a bright blade bumper on each corner and a bright step plate tucked straight under the tail, a quarter of a stud below the afterburners.

race_diffuser.name: Race Diffuser

parts.note: flat floor, no wider than the body
deep mesh corner, flush with the body side
diffuser end fence, hung from the mesh corner
long diffuser blade between the fences
kick-up block: the blade hangs from this

race_diffuser.note: GT3: a flat floor no wider than the body, deep end fences flush with the body side, and a long diffuser blade.

boot_rack.name: Boot Rack
boot_rack.note: Shooting brake: a bright boot rack on four posts with a low lip at its back edge. Needs no roof behind it.
